
         ent  $

RUN      ld   hl,16384
         ld   de,16385
         ld   bc,6143
         ld   (hl),l
         ldir
         ld   bc,768
         ld   (hl),56
         ldir

MAIN     ld   hx,31
         ld   hl,6*32+20480
         call INPUT
         cp   7
         ret  z

         ld   hl,TEXT1
         call TEXTOUT

         ld   de,23296
         call COMPUT
         push hl
         call NUMBER
         ld   hl,TEXT3
         call TEXTOUT2

         ld   hl,TEXT2
         call TEXTOUT

         pop  hl
         call NUMSIGN
         ld   hl,TEXT3
         call TEXTOUT2
         jr   MAIN



INPCLEAR ld   de,(INPOS+1)
         ld   c,16
INPC2    ld   b,hx
         inc  b
         xor  a
         push de

INPC3    ld   (de),a
         inc  de
         djnz INPC3
         pop  de
         call DOWNDE
         dec  c
         jr   nz,INPC2
         ret


INPUT    ld   (INPOS+1),hl
         ld   hl,23296
         ld   b,hx
IN1      ld   (hl),32
         inc  hl
         djnz IN1
         ld   (hl),b

         res  5,(iy+1)
         xor  a
         ld   (CURSOR+1),a

IN2      ld   b,hx
INPOS    ld   hl,0
         ld   (PPOS+1),hl
         ld   hl,23296

CURSOR   ld   c,0
IN3      ld   a,l
         cp   c
         ld   a,"C"+128
         call z,CHAR

         ld   a,(hl)
         call CHAR

         inc  hl
         djnz IN3

         ld   a,l
         cp   c
         ld   a,"<"+128
         call z,CHAR

         call INKEY
         cp   7
         ret  z
         cp   13
         jr   z,INPCLEAR

         ld   hl,IN2
         push hl
         ld   hl,CURSOR+1
         cp   8
         jr   z,CURSLEFT
         cp   9
         jr   z,CURSRGHT
         cp   12
         jr   z,BCKSPACE
         cp   199
         jr   z,DELETE
         cp   32
         ret  c
         cp   128
         ret  nc
         ex   af,af'

         ld   a,(hl)
         cp   hx
         ret  nc

         inc  (hl)
         ld   l,(hl)
         dec  l
         ld   h,23296/256

IN5      ld   a,(hl)
         or   a
         ret  z
         ex   af,af'
         ld   (hl),a
         inc  hl
         jr   IN5


CURSLEFT ld   a,(hl)
         or   a
         ret  z
         dec  (hl)
         ret


CURSRGHT ld   a,(hl)
         cp   hx
         ret  nc
         inc  (hl)
         ret


DELETE   ld   a,(hl)
         cp   hx
         ret  z
         inc  a
         jr   BCK2


BCKSPACE ld   a,(hl)
         or   a
         ret  z

         dec  (hl)

BCK2     ld   l,a
         ld   h,23296/256
         ld   e,l
         ld   d,h
         dec  e

DEL2     ld   a,(hl)
         ldi
         or   a
         jr   nz,DEL2
         ex   de,hl
         dec  hl
         ld   (hl)," "
         ret


DOWNDE   inc  d
         ld   a,d
         and  7
         ret  nz
         ld   a,e
         add  a,32
         ld   e,a
         ld   a,d
         jr   c,DOWNDE2
         sub  8
         ld   d,a
DOWNDE2  cp   88
         ret  c
         ld   d,64
         ret


INKEY    ei
         halt
         bit  5,(iy+1)
         jr   z,INKEY
         res  5,(iy+1)

         push bc
         push hl

         ld   hl,0
         ld   b,l
INKEY2   ld   a,(hl)
         inc  hl
         and  24
         or   4
         out  (254),a
         djnz INKEY2

         pop  hl
         pop  bc

         ld   a,(23560)
         ret


READSIGN ld   a,(de)
         cp   "-"
         jr   nz,READNUM
         inc  de
         call READNUM
SWAPSIGN ld   a,l
         cpl
         ld   l,a
         ld   a,h
         cpl
         ld   h,a
         inc  hl
         ret


INVCHAR  ld   a,(de)
         inc  de
         inc  de
         add  a,128
         ld   l,a
         ret


CODECHAR ld   a,(de)
         inc  de
         inc  de
         ld   l,a
         ret


READNUM  ld   a,(de)
         inc  de
         ld   hl,0

         cp   """"
         jr   z,CODECHAR

         cp   "'"
         jr   z,INVCHAR

         ld   b,16
         cp   "#"
         jr   z,READNUM3

         ld   b,2
         cp   "%"
         jr   z,READNUM3

         ld   b,10
         dec  de

READNUM3 ld   a,(de)
         sub  "0"
         cp   10
         jr   c,READNUM4
         sub  "A"-"9"-1
         cp   10
         ret  c

READNUM4 cp   16
         jr   c,READNUM6
         sub  32

READNUM6 cp   16
         ret  nc

         inc  de
         push de

         ex   de,hl
         ld   hl,0

         push bc
READNUM5 add  hl,de
         djnz READNUM5
         ld   d,b
         pop  bc

         ld   e,a
         add  hl,de

         pop  de
         jr   READNUM3


NUMSIGN  bit  7,h
         jr   z,NUMBER
         call SWAPSIGN
         push hl
         ld   a,"-"
         call CHAR
         pop  hl

NUMBER   ld   de,10000
         ld   b,0
         call N1
         ld   de,1000
         call N1
         ld   de,100
         call N1
         ld   e,10
         call N1
         ld   b,1
         ld   e,b

N1       ld   a,"0"-1
N2       inc  a
         or   a
         sbc  hl,de
         jr   nc,N2
         add  hl,de

         cp   "0"
         jr   nz,N3
         bit  0,b
         ret  z

N3       ld   b,1

CHAR     exx

         add  a,a
         ld   l,a
         sbc  a,a
         ld   c,a
         ld   h,15
         add  hl,hl
         add  hl,hl

PPOS     ld   de,16384
         push de
         ld   b,8

CHAR2    ld   a,(hl)
         rrca
         or   (hl)
         xor  c
         ld   (de),a
         call DOWNDE
         ld   a,(hl)
         xor  c
         ld   (de),a
         call DOWNDE
         inc  hl
         djnz CHAR2

         pop  de
         inc  e
         ld   a,e
         and  31
         jr   nz,CHAR3
         dec  e
         ld   a,e
         and  %11100000
         ld   e,a
         ld   b,16
CHAR4    call DOWNDE
         djnz CHAR4
CHAR3    ld   (PPOS+1),de

         exx
         ret


SEEKCHAR ld   a,(de)
         cp   " "
         ret  nz
         inc  de
         jr   SEEKCHAR


COMPUT   call SEEKCHAR
         call READSIGN
         push de

COMPUT2  pop  de
         call SEEKCHAR
         or   a
         ret  z

         push af
         push hl
         inc  de
         call SEEKCHAR
         call READSIGN
         pop  bc
         pop  af
         push de
         ld   d,b
         ld   e,c

         ld   bc,COMPUT2
         push bc

         ex   de,hl
         cp   "?"
         jr   z,MOD

         cp   "/"
         jr   z,LOM

         cp   "*"
         jr   z,KRAT

         cp   "+"
         jr   z,PLUS

         cp   "-"
         jr   z,MINUS

         pop  af
         ret


MOD      ld   a,h
         ld   c,l
         ld   hl,0
         ld   b,16
MOD2     slia c
         rla
         adc  hl,hl
         sbc  hl,de
         jr   nc,MOD1
         add  hl,de
         dec  c
MOD1     djnz MOD2
         ret


LOM      call MOD
         ld   h,a
         ld   l,c
         ret


KRAT     ld   b,16
         ld   a,h
         ld   c,l
         ld   hl,0
KRAT2    add  hl,hl
         rl   c
         rla
         jr   nc,KRAT1
         add  hl,de
KRAT1    djnz KRAT2
         ret


MINUS    or   a
         sbc  hl,de
         ret


PLUS     add  hl,de
         ret


TEXTOUT  ld   e,(hl)
         inc  hl
         ld   d,(hl)
         inc  hl
         ld   (PPOS+1),de

TEXTOUT2 ld   a,(hl)
         and  127
         call CHAR
         bit  7,(hl)
         inc  hl
         jr   z,TEXTOUT2
         ret


TEXT1    defw 18432+8
         defm 'Unsigned:'

TEXT2    defw 18432+96+8
         defm '  Signed:'

TEXT3    defm '      '
